rag.text:
Test: TC-4413 — Feature area - Risk - column add for sub-box
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-83 Feature area - Risk
Labels: teamsource

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Risks module Table view of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-4413 Feature area - Risk - column add for sub-box
   Expected: One task is visible.
2. Expand Column Manager ( gear icon ) and Add newColumnName
   Data: newColumnName: Actual Cost (Built-in)
   Expected: No error message appears.  In column manager "Restore columns" is active, "Save changes for all users" is greyed out.
3. Navigate to the Table view of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-4413 Feature area - Risk - column add for sub-box parent
   Expected: NewColumnName is visible in columns view.
4. Expand Column Manager ( gear icon )
   Expected: In column manager "Restore columns" and "Save changes for all users" are active.
5. Click on Restore columns
   Expected: NewColumnName isn't visible in columns view no more.
6. Back to the boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-4413 Feature area - Risk - column add for sub-box
   Expected: One task is visible.
7. Hover over information icon "Save changes for all users"
   Expected: The information in tooltip is presented: "You cannot save Column View inherited from the upper-level Box."
8. Hover over information icon "Restore columns"
   Expected: The information in tooltip is presented: "After adding or removing columns, you can easily return to your initial set."
